results.text:
this was my website in September 2024. exactly 2 years ago.

I was 14 years old. solo freelancer. manually coding websites. barely making $200 a month. 450 followers. just discovered Figma.

I'm 16 now.

- $165,000 revenue months
- 53K followers on twitter
- leading a 14-person team of senior designers and developers, some with 15+ years of experience
- work that is truly world class

you’d be surprised how fast your life can change if you just lock in.
